title: Counit cocycle calculation for genuine abelian injective resolutions
statement: For schemes X,Y and f:X→Y, module sheaves A,F, genuine abelian injective resolutions I,R of their underlying sheaves [def-sp-injective-resolutions], an inverse-image coefficient c and a lift L satisfying the degree-zero augmentation equation [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison], and the prescribed top-open section restriction s, the adjoint section chain map computes inverse image on sheaf Ext followed by c under the fixed comparisons [def-pc-abelian-counit-cocycle-comparisons]. No hypothesis of injectivity is imposed on forgotten module injectives.

source.place: Tags 01F7, 01F8, 01F9 and 06XR; the existing exact-functor resolution-cocycle theorem and the defining Zariski constant-sheaf comparison.

proof.text: Convert a section cycle into a closed Hom cocycle from the constant integer sheaf using the constant-sheaf adjunction and the integer generator. Precompose terminalSourceIso and apply the proved fixed site-sections normalization. This gives the source representative identity.

Apply exactFunctor_resolution_cocycle to inverse image, the coefficient c and the supplied degree-zero lift equation. Precomposition by constIso(f).inv computes the constant-source change. Compute its adjunction transpose on the actual Zariski sites and use the specified equation for s to identify the section cycle with cyclesMap of the adjoint chain map.
Apply the target fixed normalization. The source and target representative identities imply the cohomology equality for every class by surjectivity of the homology projection.

lean.statement:
theorem abelian_injective_counit_cocycle_calculation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (I : InjectiveResolution
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)).obj A))
    (c : (invImage f).obj
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)).obj A) ⟶
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj F))
    (R : InjectiveResolution
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj F))
    (L : ((invImage f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ R.cocomplex)
    (hL : (invImage f).map (I.ι.f 0) ≫ L.f 0 = c ≫ R.ι.f 0)
    (s : abelianPushforward f ⋙ abelianSections Y ≅
      abelianSections X)
    (hs : ∀ G, s.hom.app G = G.obj.map
      (eqToHom (by simp) : op (f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)) ⟶ op (⊤ : X.Opens)))
    (p : ℕ) (x : H A p) :
    ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (.up ℕ) p).map
      (((abelianSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (abelianAdjunction f).unit (.up ℕ)).app
          I.cocomplex ≫
          ((abelianPushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map L) ≫
        (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex s.hom (.up ℕ)).app R.cocomplex))
      ((abelianInjectiveResolutionIso Y A I p).hom x) =
    (abelianInjectiveResolutionIso X F R p).hom
      (Sheaf.H.map c p (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage f) (constIso f).symm
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)).obj A) p x))
